impact: A strong AI rebound helps NBIS into its Thursday report and lifts MU, DRAM and BE after Tuesday's CPI selloff; the move still depends on yields holding near 5%.
summary: AI stocks rebounded before the bell Wednesday: CoreWeave rose about 13% after its Q3 beat, Nvidia climbed about 5.2%, Credo jumped nearly 9% and Micron gained 1.5%. Nasdaq futures were up 1.6% and S&P 500 futures 0.7%, while Treasury Secretary Bessent urged the US and China to de-risk. Rocket Lab fell about 8% on a wider loss.
title: Premarket: CoreWeave +13%, Nvidia +5%, Nasdaq futures +1.6%
